scope: Paired benchmark reuses the same 314 candidate-control NPY files. Only free-object mass/density increases from 100 g to 200 g; planned grasp/squeeze targets, hand actuation, friction, mocap constraints and solver settings remain unchanged. The same controller policy computes release retreat from each trial's measured held-object pose, so its realized retreat direction may respond to load-dependent motion. Candidate selection for display may differ after physical evaluation.
mass_note: Object gravitational weight rises from approximately 0.981 N to 1.962 N. Stored squeeze controls were not re-optimized for 200 g, making this a controlled load comparison rather than a new mass-specific synthesis campaign.
